title: Your Daily AI mega update #ai #ainews #capcut
transcript: A jailbreaker just broke one of the most powerful AI models ever built using a coordinated multi-agent attack that slipped past every safety filter. The government responded by pulling it offline entirely. Then the AI's internal blueprint, 120,000 characters of safety architecture, leaked on GitHub for the world to see. And now the company that built it is calling for a global pause on AI development. This isn't a warning. This is already happening.
